result.evidence_A: About 140 words. Covers GRB970111 non-detection, GRB970228 detection, SN in GRB980425, polarization, z=4.5, the full 9-activation breakdown with the unconfirmed GRB000830-type object, and host spectrophotometry. Says 'six node consortium began' in 2000; the sixth node actually joined in December 2000, a minor misstatement. 'It also devotes' has an unclear referent.
result.evidence_B: About 140 words. Accurately covers the ToO history, consortium formation, LP start in April 2000, and milestones. Omits the five null results and the unconfirmed red object. 'Ongoing work also targets... short-duration GRB subclass' overstates the body, which lists short GRBs only as an aim. 'Since 2000' is vaguer than 'up to December 2000'.
result.comparative_reason: Both answers meet the length target and read coherently. A is more specific and includes the caveated activation outcomes the rubric names. B leaves out those caveats and presents a stated aim as ongoing work. A's six-node timing slip is minor by comparison.
